Hi Samir —

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciate the deep dive into FintechCo's latency and compliance requirements. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Recap: Redwood can support your inference workloads with dedicated capacity and VPC/private deployments to meet your data-segmentation needs. We covered expected P50 latency targets (~120ms), retention/security controls, and expected throughput for peak trading windows.
- Action: I attached our SOC 2 packet (SOC2_packet_v2.pdf) and a short security overview. This contains the SOC 2 Type II attestation, control mappings, our data handling practices, and sample audit logs.
- Asks: Can you confirm who on your security/compliance team will review the packet and whether there are any additional artifacts they need (e.g., infra diagrams, encryption details, or policies)?
- Proposed follow-up: if it helps, I can set up a 30-min call next week with Rishi from our security enablement team to walk through any gaps. Suggested times: Tue 6/30 10am ET or Wed 7/1 2pm ET.

If you prefer a single doc link instead of the attachment, here's the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SOC2packet

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
